Evidence & scope

Current provider documentation received separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI content reviews for the exact imported observations. The official labeling page offers managed text/audio/image/video annotation and expert-verified prompt-response pairs with RLHF response ratings. Qualification is managed annotation and expert feedback, without a claim of software-only delivery. Separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews are complete for the exact imported observations. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes are retained; no operational audit, commercial quality endorsement or automatic review of mentioned benchmarks is implied.
